v3_ntp_pages_default_casino_cashback_rul: Terms and Conditions
Cashback is a partial cash refund, the amount of which depends on your gaming activity. The cashback amount varies from level 1-7 according to your gaming activity.
Each new level increases both the percentage of cashback and how often you receive it. Once you’ve accumulated a certain number of experience points, you’ll go to the next level.
What is cashback?
Experience points {transcriptXP} are the points you earn for placing bets. They determine your current level in the cashback program.
What are experience points (XP)?
The number of points is calculated as follows:
* Experience points will not be awarded for bets placed in the {gamesSectionName} section.
At Copper level, you'll get 100 experience points for every €1 wagered
At Bronze level, you'll get 150 experience points for every €1 wagered
At Silver level, you'll get 200 experience points for every €1 wagered
At Gold level, you'll get 250 experience points for every €1 wagered
At Ruby level, you'll get 300 experience points for every €1 wagered
At Sapphire level, you'll get 350 experience points for every €1 wagered
At Diamond level, you'll get 400 experience points for every €1 wagered
Once you reach VIP Status, you'll get 450 experience points for every €1 wagered
How can I earn experience points (XP)?
For levels 1 to 7 (Copper - Diamond), cashback is calculated as follows:
(total stakes placed since cashback was last credited - total winnings received since cashback was last credited) x cashback %.
However, the cashback amount {strong}cannot be negative{/strong}.
In other words, players who make a profit while playing at the casino will not be awarded cashback.

For example, if your total stake amount was 500 currency units, and the total amount of winnings was 600 currency units for the entire calculation period, {strong}cashback will not be credited{/strong}.
Cashback calculation example for levels 1 through 7

At level 8 (VIP Status), cashback is calculated on the basis of every bet you place, regardless of whether it wins or loses. Please keep in mind that calculations are made up to two decimal places. So, if cashback is to be under 0.01 in your account currency, it will not be credited for this bet. Also, cashback at this level can vary depending on the game type:
you'll get 0.25% for playing Slots
you'll get 0.1% for playing Live Casino
you'll get 0.2% for playing any type of lottery (keno, bingo or scratch cards)
you'll get 0.05% for playing table games (roulette, poker, baccarat, blackjack and games from the "Other" section)
When you place bets in 'Live Casino' and table games your cashback will be calculated as follows:
Sum total of bets placed in "Live Casino" during the settlement period х 0.1% + sum total of bets placed in table games during the settlement period х 0.05% = your cashback amount.
Cashback calculation example for level 8
Some games are not included in this cashback offer.
Please consult the list below:

Live Slots, Dogs 3D, XKeno, Live Roulette, Tron 3D, Velo 3D, Penalty, Keno Night, Bingo 37, Keno Live, Bet on Horses, Fortuna, Fortune 18, Bet on Dogs, Bingo 37 Ticket, Craps, Chicago Nights, Romeo, Baccarat, Bird of Paradise, Safari Hunter, Blue Ocean, FaFaFa 2, Fishing God, Fishermen Gold, Baccarat, American Roulette, Plinko, Chinese Roulette and European Roulette.
Games excluded from the cashback program
How often you receive сashback depends on your level:
At Copper level, you’ll receive cashback once every 7 days
At Bronze level, you’ll receive cashback once every 6 days
At Silver level, you’ll receive cashback once every 5 days
At Gold level, you’ll receive cashback once every 4 days
At Ruby level, you’ll receive cashback once every 3 days
At Sapphire level, you’ll receive cashback once every 2 days
At Diamond level, you’ll receive cashback daily
With VIP Status, you’ll receive cashback daily.
How often is cashback paid out?
Any bets placed within the 24 hours prior to a cashback withdrawal request will not be included in the cashback calculation.
The cashback amount is calculated immediately, but you can only receive it on the last day of the settlement period if you have fulfilled all the terms of the cashback offer.
This cashback amount has no wagering requirement.
Customers cannot take part in the loyalty program using multiple accounts. All experience points accumulated in multiple accounts will be removed.
Other important points
